lines.zh: 我走得歪，一半机件是错的。
lines.en: I walk crooked; half my parts are wrong.

lines.zh: 电线拖在地上，一路刮响。
lines.en: Wires drag along the floor.

lines.zh: 我有两只右手，没有左手。
lines.en: I have two right hands and no left.
Four legs, and I am steadier for it.

lines.zh: 我的头挂在一边，转不正。
lines.en: My head hangs to one side and will not straighten.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条多余的手臂。
lines.en: I drag an extra arm.
My joints bend backwards, and still I walk.
The corridor's echo helps me steer.

lines.zh: 我的脚步一半是金属声。
lines.en: Half my steps are metal.

lines.zh: 我在这几条道上来来回回。
lines.en: I go back and forth along these halls.
Do not stare at how I walk.
Crooked, but quick.
I tilt my head at the corridor.
Half this body is not mine.

lines.zh: 机件在响，找不到是哪一处。
lines.en: Something clicks. I cannot find where.
I count the flickers of the bulb.
One of my eyes is green.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，可我想呼吸。
lines.en: I need no breath, yet I want to.

lines.zh: 铁皮上有一道撕开的口。
lines.en: A torn gap runs through my casing.
I listen to the camera turning.
Half my fur is gone.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看着它不属于我。
lines.en: I lift a hand and see it is not mine.
My teeth show outside my jaw.
I am not quite sure where I am.
Someone is at the end of the hall.

lines.zh: 我试着把头摆正，失败了。
lines.en: I try to straighten my head. It fails.
That lamp flickered again.
My stance is very strange.

lines.zh: 你为什么盯着我的脖子？
lines.en: Why are you staring at my neck?
I know I look wrong.
Could you set my head straight?
You have no tools in your hands.
I dislike being looked at.
Are you the one on night shift?

lines.zh: 我的声音是从坏掉的喇叭里出来的。
lines.en: My voice comes through a broken speaker.

lines.zh: 别怕，我一时半会儿不动。
lines.en: Do not fear. I will not move just yet.
Stand back; I am repairing myself.

lines.zh: 我有很多只手可以抓东西。
lines.en: I have plenty of hands for grabbing.
Did you hear that clatter?
Wires fill me under this skin.
Turn the light off.
I can see behind me too.
Are you staying in this room?

lines.zh: 我的关节比你的骨头多。
lines.en: I have more joints than your bones.

lines.zh: 我不记得自己原来的样子。
lines.en: I do not remember my original shape.
I heard you laugh.
A few of my parts came loose.

lines.zh: 散架的那半边，又滑下去一点。
lines.en: My loose half slips a little further.
I feel no pain, but I know I am damaged.
I pick up the hand that fell.
The mechanism is loud now.
I brace on the wall and straighten.
That snapped a wire.

lines.zh: 我几乎不会被推开，可我会坏。
lines.en: I am hard to shove, not hard to break.
One of my teeth chipped.
I do not eat, and I never stop.
Is that a part or food?
I take it as a spare part.
I cannot taste.
Do not snatch your hand back.
I am short exactly this screw.
That is not what I want.
Your kindness is misplaced.
I take it. You were not eating it.
My jaw does not close properly.
I have many hard corners.
Bumping me is bumping scrap iron.
I have too many arms.
You knocked a screw loose.
I am nearly impossible to shove.
I take half a step, badly.
Careful, both of us.
Shove again and I fall apart.
I cannot even piece myself together.
Half this body is not mine.
Do not. I only want quiet.
My voice is ugly.
Whom did I love? I cannot recall.
I shake my head; it tilts again.
I do not want to be touched.
That needs a whole body.
I look at you and say nothing.
My head is on backwards; I am used to it.
This will serve as a part.
I picked it up with my third hand.
It fell into my casing.
Is this my finger?
I stuff it into a gap.
Wires have tangled around it.
I need this.
I keep it for later.

lines.zh: 地上这些东西都是我的。
lines.en: These floor things are mine.

lines.zh: 线缆缠成一团，我现在才动手。
lines.en: My cables tangled; now I move.
Now it is my turn to grab.
I have plenty of hands for this.
Almost nothing can shove me back.
I cling to the wall and turn my head to you.
Every joint turns toward you.
When I laugh, the speaker rattles.
I forced my head straight.
I hear your heartbeat.
There is heat on you.
I will keep following.
Do not run. I run crooked, but fast.
Caught.
You should have left sooner.
I close in with my head cocked.
Wires trail at my feet.
Four legs make me fast.
You should not have stopped mid-hall.
My fingers are moving.
The lamp went out.
I can come closer still.
My joints click and grate.
I come at your flank.
You are counting my legs.
You have reached the wall.
I hear you swallow.
Do not raise your hands. It will not help.
A few steps now.
Stand just like that.

lines.zh: 第二张嘴在喉咙边张开。
lines.en: A second mouth opens by my throat.
Got you.

lines.zh: 我用多余的胳膊抱住你。
lines.en: I wrap an extra arm around you.
My teeth bite your pauldron.
Three hands grab at once.
I shove you into the wall.
That one came with a metal clang.

lines.zh: 我的爪尖划开你的袖子。
lines.en: My claw tip opens your sleeve.
You blocked a hand, not a foot.
My crooked swing caught you.
Once I have you, you do not leave.
Wires loop your wrist.
That was heavy.
The corner of my mouth split.

lines.zh: 我的身体，拼得乱七八糟。
lines.en: This body is pieced together wrong.

lines.zh: 断掉的手，从另一边抓你。
lines.en: A severed hand grabs you from the other side.
I throw you clear.
All torn apart, and that is the end.
I drop from the ceiling.
Half of me is somewhere else.
The light died, so I am here.

lines.zh: 我在地上爬了两下才站起。
lines.en: I crawl twice before standing.

lines.zh: 头是歪的，视野却是正的。
lines.en: My head is crooked; my view is not.
The door to this room is open.
My parts are scattered on the floor.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只不属于我的手。
lines.en: I raise a hand that is not mine.
Do you hear metal grinding?

lines.zh: 我慢慢地，一寸一寸地来。
lines.en: I come, inch by inch.
Too bright here.

lines.zh: 我的喇叭里先传出声音。
lines.en: The speaker sounds before I do.

lines.zh: 我把头摆到一个能看你的角度。
lines.en: I set my head at an angle that sees you.
Long corridor. I walked a while.
Your spot is easy to find.
I arrive trailing wires.

lines.zh: 我从通风口挤出来，别动。
lines.en: I squeeze from the vent. Do not move.
My casing melts, and it stinks.

lines.zh: 我摔散了，又抓回来一些。
lines.en: I fall apart and gather some pieces back.

lines.zh: 水进了电路，我抽了一下。
lines.en: Water in my circuits; I spasm.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，零件到处都是。
lines.en: The blast throws me; parts everywhere.

lines.zh: 一根钉子嵌进我的关节。
lines.en: A nail wedges in my joint.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的电路乱跳。
lines.en: That light makes my circuits skip.
I do not lack food. I lack power.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我全身的金属跑。
lines.en: Lightning runs through all my metal.

lines.zh: 我连自己的零件都抓不住。
lines.en: I cannot hold even my own parts.
